Academic Levels

GETI Diploma Levels

Choose your academic pathway and continue from one level to the next through structured online study, lessons and examinations.

Level 1

Baccalaureate Diploma

Foundation-level academic pathway designed to prepare students for higher study and professional specialization.

Suggested duration: 1 academic year
Level 2

Bachelor Diploma

Undergraduate-level pathway with core modules, specialization courses, assessments and a final academic project.

Suggested duration: 3 academic years
Level 3

Master 1 Diploma

Advanced study focused on specialization, research methods, professional analysis and higher-level coursework.

Suggested duration: 1 academic year after Bachelor
Level 4

Master 2 Diploma

Final advanced-level pathway with specialist modules, research or professional thesis work and final evaluation.

Suggested duration: 1 academic year after Master 1
Baccalaureate Diploma→ Bachelor Diploma→ Master 1 Diploma→ Master 2 Diploma
Academic titles such as Baccalaureate, Bachelor and Master should only be presented as officially recognized degrees where GETI has the required legal authorization or accreditation in the relevant jurisdiction.
